$comment: Packaged-test coverage for every menu item and keyboard shortcut (L6). Status: exercised = the packaged spec performs the action and asserts its effect; reachable = the packaged spec shows the item; open = no packaged test yet. Every non-open entry names a spec under tests/desktop whose text must contain the evidence string. Strict release mode (JOY_MEDIA_L6_RELEASE=1) fails while any entry is open.

shortcut.note: Space starts playback and a second Space stops it; the timecode stops advancing.
Ctrl+K opens the command palette with its search field focused.
Escape closes the palette while its search field has focus.
S splits the selected clip at the playhead.
Delete and Backspace each remove the selected clip.
Ctrl+D adds a copy of the selected clip.
Left arrow moves the playhead back one second.
Right arrow moves the playhead forward one second.
Shift+Left moves the playhead back 0.1 s.
Shift+Right moves the playhead forward 0.1 s.
Home moves the playhead to zero.
End moves the playhead to the end of the timeline.
? opens the keyboard shortcut sheet and a second ? closes it.
